== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 25 October 2020. The Facebook photo viewer names Fabien Jacques. Identification: distinctive name plus Red 71 FL on the Decipher Squadron roster (Liege, Bel). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/fabjacques and lists Huy, Belgium (same country as Liege). The uncropped original is a two-person photograph; the lead crop is Jacques alone.
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Fabien Jacques portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Fabien Jacques Facebook portrait.jpg]].
